title: Polymorphic Bottom-Up Weighted Relational Programming
comment: 54 pages, for associated repo see https://github.com/sporkl/semiringkanren
summary: This work presents a new approach for implementing polymorphism for bottom-up relational languages, without monomorphization. We begin by introducing semiringKanren, a bottom-up weighted relational programming language. We extend this base language to support polymorphism. We describe a new method to compile polymorphic semiringKanren programs into non-polymorphic ones, based on equality patterns and large-enough instances of polymorphic relations. We prove the correctness of this method. Finally, we consider existing work and suggest directions for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需单态化的多态性实现方法，用于自底向上的关系编程语言semiringKanren，通过等式模式和大实例化方法编译多态程序为非多态程序，并证明了其正确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的自底向上关系编程语言缺乏对多态性的高效支持，传统单态化方法会导致代码膨胀和效率低下，因此需要一种新的多态实现方案。
AI.method: 提出semiringKanren自底向上加权关系编程语言，并基于等式模式和大实例化（large-enough instances）将多态关系编译为非多态形式，避免单态化过程。
AI.result: 成功实现了多态性支持，并通过形式化证明验证了编译方法的正确性。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法为关系编程语言中的多态性提供了新的高效实现路径，未来可进一步探索相关研究方向。
